subject: astronomy
title: Earth, Moon & Sun: Foundations
welcome_lead: Three bodies, one cosmic dance — let's meet our nearest neighbours.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: Earth, Moon, Sun sizes, distances, motions.
final_note: Once you see the dance, day, night and seasons make sense.

concepts.def: Our home planet, the 3rd from the Sun.
Our nearest star at the centre of our system.
A curved path one object takes around another.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Moon is smaller than Earth. Earth fits inside the Sun about a million times over. Even so, the Sun looks the same size as the full Moon in our sky — it's just much further away.
The Moon orbits Earth. Earth orbits the Sun. The Sun stays near the centre of our solar system. Each body also rotates on its axis.
Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. Light from the Moon takes just over a second.
